blocks.text: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY — The fate of Vice President Sara Duterte’s defense strategy now hangs in the balance, caught between the prosecution’s potential objections and the final rulings of the Senate impeachment court, according to former Supreme Court Senior Associate Justice Antonio Carpio. His pronouncement follows the Senate impeachment court’s decision, led by presiding officer Senator Francis “Chiz” Escudero, to approve the House prosecution panel’s withdrawal of three out of four impeachment articles against the Vice President. The prosecution has opted to proceed solely with Article II, which centers on allegations of unexplained wealth and failure to disclose assets. They […]...
